title: CoRoGS Contextual Gaussian Splatting for Robust Large-Deviation View Synthesis
one_line: 图神经网络增强高斯溅射提升大视角偏差渲染
innovations: 3D Gaussian Graph with message passing for relational geometry and semantics
Progressive graph expansion strategy for coherent scene reconstruction
method_framework: CoRoGS constructs a 3D Gaussian Graph where each node represents a Gaussian with geometric and semantic attributes. A Graph Neural Network performs contextual reasoning through message passing, enabling context-aware Gaussian updates. A progressive graph expansion mechanism adaptively grows and prunes Gaussians to maintain structural consistency.
experiment_framework: Evaluated on KITTI and Waymo datasets under supervised (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS) and unsupervised (FID, KID, Chamfer Distance) settings with various view deviations (lateral, vertical, diagonal). Compared against GaussianPro, SAGS, DC-Gaussian, GSDF, VEGS, and DeSiRe-GS.
takeaways: Graph-based contextual reasoning significantly improves geometric consistency in large-deviation scenarios
Cross-modal fusion of geometric and semantic features enhances rendering quality while preserving boundaries
weaknesses: Computational complexity increases due to graph construction and message passing
Method relies on MVS initialization which may limit performance in extremely sparse view scenarios
relevance_reason: 大视角偏差渲染与可靠性主线有交点但颗粒度不足
